findings.summary: The surface pattern used to be case-sensitive (/\bAISDLC-\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b/ with no flag). The rebuilt pattern adds the 'i' flag, so lower-case text such as 'aisdlc-12' now counts as a surface signal. This contradicts the claim that AISDLC behaviour is unchanged. Impact is low, because the new matches are task-id-shaped and gate 3 and the resolver already match case-insensitively. Drop the flag, or note it as intended.
